text: It happens in affairs of state, for when the evils that arise have been foreseen (which it is only given to a wise man to see), they can be quickly redressed, but when, through not having been foreseen, they have been permitted to grow in a way that every one can see them, there is no longer a remedy.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
location: Sant'Andrea in Percussina, near Florence, Italy
